我想爱上这款游戏，因为它的背景设定在一个受《萤火虫》和《无垠的太空》等酷炫剧集启发的地方。我也完全痴迷于造船，但好的部分到此为止。

我为这款游戏等了多年，而它在这种状态下发布1.0，是对那些支持它的人的侮辱。我再也不会买Bluebottle Studios的任何游戏了。

items.text:
I love this game to death, I love its concept, I love the mechanics, I love how each update added a lot of brand new content to the game. I love the ship building, I love the writing, I love the lore, I love the music....

I can't recommed this game. The main reason is that it doesn't respect your time. This is a multi layered issue and I'll explain.

In its state that it has been for years (and will resume to be), the game just runs like complete and utter ♥♥♥♥ and the performance has only gotten far worse. The game is optimized for higher end rigs so if you got a mediocre laptop, you'll struggle to run it. I've lost countless hours combined from crashes and corrupt saves, that's another big flaw. The game will save but in the save folder, the save.info file will be missing so you think you saved the game, quit and you lost all your work. With the 0.15 update, the patch notes toted that they upgraded performance. That's bs, the game runs worse on a fresh save than it did before. More crashes as well, BUT, it does handle long running games better than it did before, I'll give them that. So the baseline performance of the game was hampered, the garbage control (RAM reallocation) improved so you no longer have to restart your game ideally every 2 hours (that's right, that used to be a thing, there were AND STILL ARE serious memory leak issues). Big ships will slow your game down heavily, and this promotes the same limiting mentality on creativity that dwarf fortress also possesses: You limit your projects to something smaller scale so the engine/your pc can run the game and it doesn't run on 2 FPS as your projects become more entropic.

There's a lot of other issues that fall under the curtain and get brushed aside because the game is still in early access, but just because a game is in early access, doesn't give it a forcefield from criticism that disallows it from getting any flak for the current state of implemented features. I say this because I want to address some core features of the game that are flawed on a fundamental level, that are broken but not because the game is in early access. That's the other thing. It's the assumption that a feature, mechanic, system in an early access game is going to get fixed or improved once 1.0 comes out or after. No, these cases are rare to begin with and it varies from feature to feature. The AI's piloting is ♥♥♥♥, has always been ♥♥♥♥ and will resume to be ♥♥♥♥, the AI on station is also just surface level implementation, though the social combat system looks really in-depth, it's incredibly shallow, as most social actions are boilerplate. There have been tweaks and modifications to AI behavior in patch notes and this is the state they are in after so much refinement. Not very encouraging.

The monthly update reports that I viewed ever since 0.13.x days have had many niche logic bugs that come from the inherent complex systems of the game (temperature, durability, inventory system, weight etc.). This makes it far harder and much slower to diagnose and address game breaking bugs. The team's progress is glacial, and a lot of their efforts are spent on trying to maintain the game in a playable state, which they are failing at.

If we removie all that negativity, you have the economy system which is the progression path of the game as you start from a junker ship and a mortgage. The economy is busted and imbalanced, money is completely trivial and it neither rewards the player for hard work, neither does it punish appropriately like when they break the law or pay fines for overdue payments. You can commit a murder and the cops will fine you 15.000 dollars which is a pitance. That mortgage is also getting paid off really fast, don't worry. 

Gameplay wise, the game as a sandbox is pretty empty. Still is in version 0.15 even after they added ship combat and asteroid mining. You have little to no insentive sadly because it's again unbalanced. AI just sits there and takes it while you shoot them, they can't battle with you properly because the piloting AI is so bad. Asteroid mining is subpar to trading wares OR the even more busted gig economy, which was broken even more with the addition of long range travel. You can now pickup a gig in Kleg, Venus or Ceres that's on another planet, have it pay a premium because it's a few astral units away from your location, take a ferry to said location instantly (yes INSTANTLY, they don't even bother simulating travel time with a ferry) and voila, you just made 4-9 million dollars with 0 effort.

So the game is unbalanced, runs like a corpse, the AI is braindead, so what else is there? The main thing? Shipbuilding. That's it. Shipbuilding. It does it really ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ well and it's super fun and relaxing to build your ship. It's a really cathartic process. You get to build your mini home in space and there's seriously indepth customization for it (waiting for them to add planters to the sundries kiosk). It's the main selling point of the game. It's just a shame that other features in the game aren't polished to even a fraction of a fraction that shipbuilding has. Also, sadly, shipbuilding takes a long time to do in general (stripping apart ships, putting them together, repairing them, etc.) and you can't realistically do this whilst also juggling a fulltime job, or have a life. Ostranauts is not for people who have limited time.

TL;DR: Ostranauts has a lot of amazing ideas and concepts but fails at executing them. It runs really bad (lots of crashes and corrupt saves, lots of memory leak within a short amount of time), its AI is really simplistic and has no depth to it, the combat is shamefully undercooked and easy, economy is completely unbalanced which doesn't challenge or reward the player, development is super slow and the updates don't address core fundamental issues... but hey, the shipbuilding is fun.

I hate it but I'll still play it and keep following the development closely. I already know realistically what the devs can and can't do with the shoestring budget they got and the time they have but still praying for a miracle cause I care about Ostranauts. I know the game's performance will forever be ♥♥♥♥, that the AI will forever be stupid and boring, that the economy will be broken and unbalanced, and that the combat will be busted and favor the player... but I still hold out some hope. As it is though, this game isn't for anyone who has a life
items.text_zh:
我爱这款游戏爱到死，我爱它的概念，我爱它的机制，我爱每次更新都为游戏添加大量全新内容。我爱造船，我爱它的文字，我爱它的背景设定，我爱它的音乐……

我不能推荐这款游戏。主要原因是它不尊重你的时间。这是一个多层次的问题，我会解释。

在它多年来一直处于（并将继续处于）的状态下，游戏运行起来就像一坨彻头彻尾的♥♥♥♥，而且性能只会越来越糟。游戏是为高端配置优化的，所以如果你只有一台平庸的笔记本电脑，你会很难运行它。我因为崩溃和存档损坏已经累计损失了无数小时，这是另一个大缺陷。游戏会保存，但在存档文件夹里，save.info文件会缺失，所以你以为自己保存了游戏，退出后就丢失了所有工作成果。随着0.15更新，补丁说明吹嘘他们升级了性能。那是胡说八道，游戏在新存档上运行得比以前更糟。崩溃也更多了，但是，它处理长时间运行的游戏确实比以前好了，这点我承认。所以游戏的基础性能被削弱了，垃圾控制（RAM重新分配）改善了，所以你不再需要理想情况下每2小时重启一次游戏（没错，这曾经是常态，曾经存在而且现在仍然存在严重的内存泄漏问题）。大型飞船会严重拖慢你的游戏，这助长了与《矮人要塞》相同的限制创造力的心态：你把项目限制在较小规模，这样引擎/你的电脑才能运行游戏，不至于随着你的项目变得更加混乱而让游戏以2 FPS运行。

还有很多其他问题被掩盖在帷幕之下，被搁置一旁，因为游戏仍处于抢先体验阶段，但仅仅因为一款游戏处于抢先体验阶段，并不意味着它有一层免受批评的力场，不允许它因当前已实现功能的状态而受到任何抨击。我这么说是因为我想指出游戏中一些在根本层面上就有缺陷的核心功能，它们是坏的，但并不是因为游戏处于抢先体验阶段。这是另一回事。那就是一种假设，认为抢先体验游戏中的某个功能、机制、系统会在1.0发布时或之后得到修复或改进。不，这些情况本来就很少见，而且因功能而异。AI的驾驶技术是♥♥♥♥，一直都是♥♥♥♥，并将继续是♥♥♥♥，空间站上的AI也只是表面层次的实现，虽然社交战斗系统看起来非常深入，但它极其肤浅，因为大多数社交行动都是模板化的。补丁说明中对AI行为有过调整和修改，这就是经过如此多打磨后它们所处的状态。不太令人鼓舞。

自0.13.x时代以来我查看的每月更新报告中有许多小众逻辑错误，这些错误来自游戏固有的复杂系统（温度、耐久度、库存系统、重量等）。这使得诊断和解决破坏游戏的错误变得更加困难和缓慢。团队的进展如冰川般缓慢，他们的很多精力都花在试图维持游戏的可玩状态上，而他们在这方面正在失败。

如果我们去掉所有这些负面内容，你还有经济系统，它是游戏的进程路径，因为你从一艘破烂飞船和一笔抵押贷款开始。经济系统是崩坏的且不平衡的，金钱完全微不足道，它既不奖励玩家的辛勤工作，也不在玩家违法或为逾期付款缴纳罚款时进行适当的惩罚。你可以犯下谋杀罪，警察只会罚你15,000美元，这简直是杯水车薪。那笔抵押贷款也会很快还清，别担心。

从玩法上看，这款游戏作为沙盒相当空洞。即使在0.15版本中，即使他们添加了飞船战斗和小行星采矿，情况依然如此。遗憾的是，你几乎没有动力，因为它再次不平衡。AI只是坐在那里挨打，当你射击它们时，它们无法与你正常战斗，因为驾驶AI太差了。小行星采矿不如交易货物，也不如更加崩坏的零工经济，而后者随着长途旅行的加入变得更加崩坏。你现在可以在Kleg、Venus或Ceres接一个在另一个星球上的零工，因为它离你的位置有几个天文单位远而支付溢价，然后立即乘坐渡轮前往该地点（是的，立即，他们甚至懒得模拟渡轮的旅行时间），瞧，你刚刚以0努力赚了400万到900万美元。

所以游戏不平衡，运行得像一具尸体，AI是脑死亡的，那还有什么？主要的东西？造船。就是这样。造船。它做得非常♥♥♥♥♥♥♥好，建造你的飞船超级有趣且放松。这是一个非常宣泄的过程。你可以建造你在太空中的迷你家园，而且有非常深入的定制（等待他们在杂货亭添加花盆）。这是游戏的主要卖点。只是遗憾的是，游戏中的其他功能连造船功能的一小部分的一小部分都没有打磨到。而且，遗憾的是，造船总体上需要很长时间（拆解飞船、组装、修理等），你无法在兼顾全职工作或拥有生活的同时现实地做到这一点。Ostranauts不适合时间有限的人。

TL;DR：Ostranauts有很多惊人的想法和概念，但在执行上失败了。它运行得非常糟糕（大量崩溃和存档损坏，短时间内大量内存泄漏），它的AI非常简陋且没有深度，战斗可耻地欠火候且简单，经济完全不平衡，既不挑战也不奖励玩家，开发超级缓慢，更新没有解决核心根本问题……但是嘿，造船很有趣。

我讨厌它，但我仍然会玩它并密切关注开发进展。我已经现实地知道开发者用他们那点微薄预算和有限时间能做什么和不能做什么，但仍然祈祷奇迹，因为我在乎Ostranauts。我知道游戏的性能将永远是♥♥♥♥，AI将永远愚蠢无聊，经济将永远崩坏不平衡，战斗将永远崩坏且偏向玩家……但我仍然抱有一些希望。不过就目前而言，这款游戏不适合任何有生活的人

Stability: I was experiencing a ton of crashes when I first started, still crashes, but now that I've restarted a new run, it's rare. 
Fun: It's fun if you like this kind of thing. The social status juggling is pretty lame atm, hopefully it gets fleshed out into something more than having to do some pointless interactions every 24 hours to not be horny and sad.
NOTICE FOR NEWBIES: Do not mortgage your soul to get the super damaged ship. Unless you can figure out repairs quickly while still making enough money to not be sold off to organ harvesters. This is I think what was causing me issues. Several of the bulkheads and floors were next to 0% durability and would fail randomly. This, I think was also causing crashes.

I give Ostranauts two bruised and fractured thumbs up. 

As one can see by glancing at the reviews, this game is not for everyone. It may require extra patience than more accessible games. But players who want to dive in deep to the simulation and atmosphere will have an absolute blast. I'll get it out the way that this game can be buggy. Items randomly disappear and an interactable object may break your game but these issues were resolved with reloading  As you play it, it sort of feels like the whole thing is being held together precariously with the very same patches you will use to repair your ship in-game. There is a tutorial that I believe has been reworked over the years that is very good (if you are okay with reading). 

All of that being said, Ostranauts is a one-of-a-kind experience for the niche audience it will hold. The gameplay, music, and artistic direction are so immersive.  Few games have made me want to read flight manuals just for the worldbuilding. Even the jankiness is immersive, which is not an easy feat for a modern game.

When I first gave Ostranauts a try I didn't know it was published by Kitfox Games. It makes perfect sense as this game sits with Caves Of Qud, Dwarf Fortress, and others as representative of a wave of deep and complex PC games that are all mostly still being developed. I expect a lot of fun out of Ostranauts for the forseeable future as they release new updates!

我给《Ostranauts》两个淤青且骨折的赞。

从评论一眼就能看出，这款游戏并不适合所有人。它可能比那些更易上手的游戏需要更多耐心。但想要深入沉浸于模拟和氛围的玩家会玩得非常尽兴。我先把话说在前头，这款游戏可能会有bug。物品会随机消失，一个可交互物体可能会弄坏你的游戏，但这些问题都能通过重新加载解决。玩的时候，你会感觉整个东西就像是用你在游戏里修船用的那些补丁勉强拼凑起来的。有一个教程，我相信这些年来被重做过，非常不错（如果你不介意阅读的话）。

话虽如此，《Ostranauts》对于它所面向的小众受众来说是一种独一无二的体验。玩法、音乐和艺术方向都极具沉浸感。很少有游戏能让我仅仅为了世界观构建而想读飞行手册。甚至连它的粗糙感都很有沉浸感，这对一款现代游戏来说可不是容易做到的事。

我第一次尝试《Ostranauts》时并不知道它是由Kitfox Games发行的。这完全说得通，因为这款游戏与《Qud洞穴》、《矮人要塞》等作品并列，代表了一波深度且复杂的PC游戏，而这些游戏大多仍在开发中。在可预见的未来，随着他们发布新更新，我期待从《Ostranauts》中获得大量乐趣！

[edit: 4/30/26 i will add how my opinions have changed after the last massive update in brackets]

So I don't usually write novels like this, but I really like this game and hope that more people buy it. That being said, I am being honest, and hope that you can get a good picture of your possible purchase.

Ostranauts rules. It has a type of depth that a lot of games lack.
It lays in-between a technical simulator and an rpg.

It's so good, that it makes you crave more, and a lot of people have a negative reaction to that feeling.

I'll do a bulletpoint list to line out my opinions.

Negatives, in descending order of severity:

1. Performance issues.
 It's not dependent on your computer, but the game has significant hiccups, especially during time dilation like 16x speed. [edit: i've played this on windows and linux (proton expiremental), and the performance issues seem mostly smoothed out.]

2. Bugs.
 There are bugs and your game will crash sometimes. The bugs have become less prevalent, as the devs do work to improve things, and it's never destroyed any of my save files. I have almost 500 hours in the game and it has crashed twice. [they have fixed a lot of bugs and continue to fix new ones]

3. End game content.
End game content isn't completely fleshed out, and according to the devs, somewhat depends on game sales to keep them on project. [they have added a lot more end-game content, including ship to ship combat. i haven't gotten that far, but everybody is saying it is really cool]

4. Stilted conversation.
 The random conversations are arbitrary, and most of the time you converse to receive a mood boost. Example: You may "lightly touch" someone in conversation. This gives you a slight +intimacy mood boost. They may respond with a "back off!" which penalizes you with a slight -self worth debuff, or something like that. Your character also has an annoying level of personal, emotional needs.

5. Awkward combat.
 Some people complain about this one, but I don't think it's that bad. It's real-time with a toggle for auto-pause which makes it turn based.
I think they don't like it because they get frustrated when their unskilled, tired, weak space monkey can't smash things like skyrim guy. You can absolutely build a dangerous character, btw.

6. Woke haircuts.
 The game doesn't shove down your throat that x=good, y=bad, so while there a lot of non-binaries, etc., there are also plenty of "normal" characters and it literally does not matter in this game. It's quite nice, imo. I included this because a lot of people have a problem with forced messaging, and I want to communicate everything.


If you can live with these things, then a unique experience awaits you.

Positives:

1. It's unique.
 There is no other game like this.  Let me repeat that for the people in the back. There is no other game like this. A lot of technical games lack a compelling human element. And a lot of games centered on the human experience lack any crunch to challenge you.  
So it's not absolutely technical. It lets you fudge some things, like going into a vacuum without a helmet doesn't immediately kill you. But neither is it just a game about chit chatting with every npc to build your reputation or whatever. It inhabits a very satisfying middle ground. 
This is an indie game made with love, and it reminds an old timer gamer like me of how games kind of used to be. They are not copying anything.

2. The main grind is fun.
 It's really fun to strip ships, salvage things, cobble them onto your ship, and get rich. Because of the time dilation, I can either enjoy a relaxing, zen-like experience on slow mode, or I can crank the speed up to get things done.

3. You can do what you want.
 It is "open world", and it has what a lot of open world games lack. It saddles you with a strong motive to hit that grind. You start the game with a massive mortgage that steadily drains your cash. You race the clock to pay it off, and it's pretty cathartic the first time you do.
You can make serious money via piracy, odd jobs, salvaging, inter-planetary trade (with active stock market)... and that might be it. But you're not stuck to just one thing.

4. It really lends itself towards immersion.
 Unlike most games, the time progression in-game is very slow. In 1x mode, a game second is only slightly faster than an real second. It's kind of hard to describe, but it's nice to play a game in which you can bust your @$$ and make life altering money in a few days. 
You can rename every item, so I like to make themed characters. I made a "space samurai" with a katana that I named "Masamune", and I renamed all of his equipment after Japanese themes. You get the idea.
You have tons of liberties when you create your character. You can make a vengeful, lustful, short-sighted, bar-room brawler that can't go an hour without a cigarette, or you can make the more typical anemic space nerd. It's up to you, and any type of character can succeed.

5. The game is visceral.
When an oxygen tank bursts because you set up the pump wrong, or your cabin depressurized from an meteorite hit, or a pirate stabs you and destroys your space suit, it is intense. The sound design is superb (except for those loud footsteps) [they fixed the footseps ;o;]. Your atmosphere alarms will be going off as your character tries to crawl to safety. I have had characters barely maintain consciousness but make it to the medbay whilst leaking blood everywhere. I have had characters die to my own stupid mistakes. You will live or die purely off of your own preparation, knowledge, experience, etc., and it makes the things you do consequential.
[now there are fires, smoke hazards, and more combat. more alarms! more sensors! more action!]

Anyway. I told myself that I wouldn't play this game until the next update, but I can't help myself. It's just too good. And since I realized that, I thought I would spend the time to write a review.

[编辑：4/30/26 我会在方括号中补充在最近一次大型更新后我的看法有何变化]

我通常不写这么长的评论，但我真的很喜欢这款游戏，希望更多人购买它。话虽如此，我是诚实的，希望你能对你可能的购买有一个清晰的了解。

Ostranauts 太棒了。它拥有许多游戏所缺乏的那种深度。
它介于技术模拟器和角色扮演游戏之间。

它好到让你渴望更多，而很多人对这种感觉会有负面反应。

我会用要点列表来列出我的看法。

缺点，按严重程度降序排列：

1. 性能问题。
 这不取决于你的电脑，但游戏有明显的卡顿，尤其是在16倍速这样的时间膨胀期间。[编辑：我在 Windows 和 Linux（proton experimental）上玩过，性能问题似乎基本已经解决了。]

2. Bug。
 有 bug，你的游戏有时会崩溃。随着开发者努力改进，bug 已经不那么常见了，而且它从未毁掉过我的任何存档。我在游戏里玩了将近500小时，它崩溃过两次。[他们修复了很多 bug，并继续修复新的 bug]

3. 终局内容。
终局内容还没有完全充实，据开发者说，某种程度上取决于游戏销量来让他们继续留在项目上。[他们添加了更多终局内容，包括舰对舰战斗。我还没玩到那么远，但大家都说非常酷]

4. 生硬的对话。
 随机对话很随意，大多数时候你交谈是为了获得情绪提升。例如：你可以在对话中“轻轻触碰”某人。这会给你一个轻微的 +亲密 情绪提升。他们可能会回应“退后！”，这会给你一个轻微的 -自我价值 减益，或者类似的东西。你的角色还有烦人的个人情感需求。

5. 别扭的战斗。
 有些人抱怨这一点，但我觉得没那么糟。它是实时的，有一个自动暂停开关，可以把它变成回合制。
我认为他们不喜欢它，是因为当他们那个没技能、疲惫、弱小的太空猴子不能像天际主角那样砸东西时，他们会感到沮丧。顺便说一句，你绝对可以打造一个危险的角色。

6. 觉醒发型。
 游戏不会把 x=好、y=坏 硬塞进你喉咙里，所以虽然有很多非二元性别者等等，也有很多“正常”角色，而在这款游戏里这根本不重要。在我看来，这相当不错。我提到这一点是因为很多人对强行灌输信息有意见，我想把所有事情都传达出来。


如果你能忍受这些事情，那么一个独特的体验在等着你。

优点：

1. 它很独特。
 没有其他游戏像这样。让我为后面的人再重复一遍。没有其他游戏像这样。很多技术类游戏缺乏引人入胜的人性元素。而很多以人类体验为核心的游戏又缺乏任何挑战你的硬核内容。  
所以它不是绝对技术性的。它允许你在一些事情上通融，比如不戴头盔进入真空不会立刻杀死你。但它也不只是一款通过和每个 NPC 闲聊来建立声望之类的游戏。它占据了一个非常令人满意的中间地带。 
这是一款用爱制作的独立游戏，它让我这样的老玩家想起游戏曾经的样子。他们没有抄袭任何东西。

2. 主要的刷资源很有趣。
 拆解飞船、打捞东西、把它们拼装到你的船上并致富，真的很有趣。由于时间膨胀，我既可以在慢速模式下享受放松、禅意般的体验，也可以把速度调快来完成任务。

3. 你可以做你想做的事。
 它是“开放世界”，而且它拥有很多开放世界游戏所缺乏的东西。它给你一个强烈的动机去刷资源。你开始游戏时背负着一笔巨额抵押贷款，它会不断消耗你的现金。你和时间赛跑还清它，第一次还清时相当解压。
你可以通过海盗行为、零工、打捞、行星际贸易（有活跃的股票市场）……赚大钱，可能就这些了。但你并不局限于只做一件事。

4. 它真的很有沉浸感。
 与大多数游戏不同，游戏内的时间推进非常慢。在1倍模式下，游戏中的一秒只比现实中的一秒稍快一点。这有点难以描述，但玩一款你可以在几天内拼命努力并赚到改变人生的钱的游戏，感觉很好。 
你可以重命名每一件物品，所以我喜欢制作有主题的角色。我制作了一个“太空武士”，拿着一把我命名为“正宗”的武士刀，并且我按照日本主题重命名了他所有的装备。你懂的。
你在创建角色时有大量自由。你可以做一个复仇心强、好色、目光短浅、一小时不抽烟就受不了的酒吧斗殴者，也可以做更典型的贫血太空书呆子。这取决于你，任何类型的角色都能成功。

5. 游戏很有冲击力。
当一个氧气罐因为你设置泵错误而爆裂，或者你的船舱因陨石撞击而失压，或者一个海盗刺伤你并毁掉你的太空服时，那种感觉非常紧张。音效设计非常出色（除了那些响亮的脚步声）[他们修复了脚步声 ;o;]。当你的角色试图爬向安全地带时，你的大气警报会响起。我曾有角色勉强保持意识，一路流血爬到医疗舱。我曾有角色死于我自己的愚蠢错误。你的生死完全取决于你自己的准备、知识、经验等等，这让你所做的事情充满后果。
[现在有火灾、烟雾危害和更多战斗。更多警报！更多传感器！更多动作！]

总之。我告诉自己在下一次更新之前不玩这款游戏，但我忍不住。它实在太好了。既然我意识到了这一点，我想我应该花时间写一篇评论。

它是“开放世界”，而且拥有许多开放世界游戏所缺少的东西。它给你一个强烈的动机去肝。你开局就背着一大笔抵押贷款，它会不断消耗你的现金。你要争分夺秒地还清它，而第一次还清时相当解压。

I had fun till now and want to see how it develops. Right now it's sims in space

Learning curve is there but tutorial tells you main things: undocking, docking and scrapping. And that's your main game loop, it gets boring after a while so you can take some gigs in between. Gigs are quests like delivery of item, seduction or investigate death - go to ship, find body, check if it's really dead and go back. Investigate death is probably the best source of money, quick cash and informations about world if you have skill to hack pda. Sometimes you find pirates so it gets more fun. 

That's pretty much the full gaming experience outside of some interesting encounters and one plot. Soon dev is going to add ship to ship combat so there will be one more reason to grind. Sadly most mechanics of the game are rarely important and that's the main problem with this game. It changes a bit when you get better tools and suit but it takes one hour to get best tools and space suit, maybe a few more to find better weapons. Skills increase speed at which you work but it doesn't really impact game. There are 2 things that change experience - interplanetary travell and crew management, those breakpoints made game fun again after scavenging got boring. I belive that this game would benefit from more dwarf fortress-like approach where various mechanics interact to make game more surprising. It would solve problems with depth, especialy with few more types of work to do. Now relations with npcs are almost meaningless, fights are fun but rarely happen, there is no reson to attack npc unless gig tells you to so it would use some more features too.

Least important is technical state. it's fine, crashes happen rarely, lately something happened and i get crash when turning game off so it doesn't matter anyway. More problematic stuff are ocassional staggering once per in-game minute when speed is set to x16 and long loading times on stations. To sum up technical state is good enough without game breaking bugs.

Overall it's nice experience for 20-40 hours but it lacks some kind of mechanics that pushes you to play longer, scrap more, get bigger ship or more crewmates unless you want to build the best looking ship in space.

As an example: lately i contacted other ship, recruited it's only passanger and now... i cant't fly his ship because it's not mine... Game shouldn't let me do it, also kidnapping people is unresponsive andbounty hunting doesnt really exist (i think it should because you actually can get some cash from giving authorities info about someone's death so it's "almost implemented". As for some more lategame stuff maybe pirate bases (both as friends and enemies), station building (you can have your asteroid base so it's also not so hard to implement), maybe even add mining so stations will demand water for hydrogen and oxygen from ice which should make world more living... Those are just examples but for such a nice game it's kinda sad that those features aren't even planned. Even if it won't be in final game i hope for some dlcs with new features because of how much more this game can be.
items.text_zh:
到目前为止我玩得很开心，想看看它会如何发展。现在它就像是太空中的模拟人生

学习曲线是有的，但教程会告诉你主要的事情：脱离对接、对接和拆解。这就是你的主要游戏循环，过一段时间会变得无聊，所以你可以在这期间接一些零工。零工是像运送物品、诱惑或调查死亡这样的任务——去飞船，找到尸体，检查它是否真的死了，然后回去。调查死亡可能是最好的赚钱来源，快速现金，如果你有破解PDA的技能，还能获得关于世界的信息。有时你会遇到海盗，所以会变得更有趣。

这基本上就是除了某些有趣的遭遇和一个剧情之外的完整游戏体验。很快开发者会加入飞船对飞船的战斗，所以会有又一个刷的理由。遗憾的是，游戏的大多数机制很少重要，这就是这个游戏的主要问题。当你获得更好的工具和套装时，情况会有所改变，但获得最好的工具和太空服需要一个小时，也许再多几个小时才能找到更好的武器。技能会提高你工作的速度，但并不会真正影响游戏。有两件事会改变体验——行星际旅行和船员管理，这些突破点让游戏在拾荒变得无聊之后再次变得有趣。我相信这个游戏会受益于更像《矮人要塞》的方式，让各种机制相互作用，使游戏更令人惊讶。这会解决深度问题，尤其是再多几种工作类型。现在与NPC的关系几乎毫无意义，战斗很有趣但很少发生，除非零工告诉你，否则没有理由攻击NPC，所以它也需要更多功能。

最不重要的是技术状态。它还行，崩溃很少发生，最近出了点事，我在关闭游戏时会崩溃，所以反正也无所谓。更有问题的是当速度设置为x16时，每游戏分钟偶尔会卡顿，以及空间站上漫长的加载时间。总之技术状态足够好，没有破坏游戏的bug。

总体而言，这是20-40小时的愉快体验，但它缺乏某种推动你玩得更久、拆解更多、获得更大飞船或更多船员的机制，除非你想建造太空中最好看的飞船。

举个例子：最近我联系了另一艘飞船，招募了它唯一的乘客，现在……我不能驾驶他的飞船，因为它不是我的……游戏不应该让我这么做，而且绑架人没有反应，赏金狩猎也并不真正存在（我认为它应该存在，因为你实际上可以通过向当局提供某人死亡的信息来获得一些现金，所以它“几乎实现了”。至于一些更多的后期内容，也许海盗基地（既作为朋友也作为敌人）、空间站建设（你可以拥有自己的小行星基地，所以实现起来也不那么难），甚至也许加入采矿，这样空间站会需要来自冰的水来获取氢和氧，这应该会让世界更有生气……这些只是例子，但对于这样一个好游戏来说，有点遗憾的是这些功能甚至都没有计划。即使它不会出现在最终游戏中，我也希望有一些带有新功能的DLC，因为这个游戏还能有这么多潜力。

items.text:
This game is chock full of severe, game-breaking, run-ruining bugs, many of which have been in the game for multiple years with no indication they will be fixed any time soon. The typical playthrough ends when the game is eventually rendered unplayable by steadily accumulating glitches, which happens sooner or later every single time.  It's a testament to how good the underlying idea is that it's still one of the best games I've played in years.

You should buy this game if it looks at all interesting, you're probably going to love it, you just need to understand what you're getting.  This is not a finished product.  It's a rough, work-in-progress development build of an absolute masterpiece.  There is jank absolutely everywhere.  Your game will crash sometimes.  Your saves will be corrupted. Your NPC crew will, if they can ever reach a treadmill, run on that treadmill until they die of exhaustion. The AI will occasionally decide to jump out of airlocks without suits or helmets. Your need bars will routinely duplicate themselves, resulting in infinite exhaustion that can never be cleared no matter how much you sleep.  And when it works, it won't matter, because you'll be having a blast.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏充满了严重的、破坏游戏、毁掉存档的漏洞，其中许多已经在游戏里存在了好几年，没有任何迹象表明它们会在短期内被修复。典型的游玩过程最终会以游戏因不断累积的故障而变得无法游玩告终，每一次都迟早会发生。这证明了其底层创意有多好，因为它仍然是我多年来玩过的最好的游戏之一。

如果这款游戏看起来哪怕有一点意思，你就应该买它，你可能会爱上它，你只需要明白自己买的是什么。这不是一个完成品。它是一款绝对杰作的粗糙、开发中的版本。到处都是粗糙感。你的游戏有时会崩溃。你的存档会损坏。你的NPC船员，如果它们能走到跑步机前，就会一直跑到累死为止。AI偶尔会决定不穿宇航服或头盔就从气闸跳出去。你的需求条会经常自我复制，导致无限的疲惫，无论你睡多久都无法清除。而当它正常运作时，这些都无所谓，因为你会玩得非常开心。

items.text:
So I somehow came into possession of a ship.   It wasn't cheap and the loan I had to pay off came with payments fast approaching.  There was only 100 credits in my account so I did the only logical thing and set out on an illegal salvage mission (no permit required).  My luck was strong apparently; I found a salvage permit on the first ship I docked with that still had 12 hours of time remaining on it.  I quickly set to work stripping the ship of valuable materials while my ship slowly leaked air into the unforgiving vacuum of space.

I returned to the station and sold the thrusters and other basic parts of the ship I had managed to somehow dock with on my first foray into the void.  I was able to cover my loan payment and even my docking fees which meant I had some time to spend repairing my ship so I would at least be able to depend on it holding air so I could keep breathing.

I headed out again and again, slowly saving enough money to buy some food, some water, and building up my exhaustion with overworking myself.
	
Apparently my luck was a one time event.  As I returned to the station after salvaging a few more low value parts my nav console crashed as I approached OKLG.  I furiously tried to debug it to regain control of the ship but ended up colliding with the station at over 100 meters per second.  They didn't care considering this wasn't the first time some novice commanders had maneuvered around their station but it knocked me out cold.
	
I woke up with internal bleeding, a concussion, and a broken arm.  I had barely enough salvage to pay for my docking fees and some oxygen so the only option I had was to head back out into the darkness.  Luck was again with me, if only slightly, for I found an abandoned vessel in the bone yard with a plethora of valuable parts. I went to work uninstalling them and almost immediately blacked out from pain and blood loss.  I somehow woke up to the CO2 alarm on my simple pressure suit and manage to drag a crate of valuable items back to my ship.  Two more times I went, passing out both times but somehow not suffocating, and I brought back some valuable pieces of a broken fusion reactor onto my ship.

Once back on my ship I headed towards OKLG with a slight offset in my trajectory.  If my nav computer failed again I wouldn't collide with anything.  This is a lesson I wouldn't forget and obtaining a second nav computer was one of the highest priorities in my mind.  I made it to the station and after only passing out from pain one more time I had managed to restore function to some of my salvaged items and sell them for enough credits to visit the health care kiosk.  After a quick injection of nanobots I bough a meal from the vending machine that made me feel like a millionaire and sat down to eat it and rest in front of the tv until my bleeding stopped.  After all of this I went to wash up and sleep in a bed in some random dirty room in the port of OKLG.  Somehow I was still alive and not yet broke.

This continued, salvage, loan payments, food, and sleep.  All of this without further life threatening injury thankfully.

I finally saved up enough money to hire my first crew member.  I felt proud of myself for having someone join my crew so easily.  My ship was somewhat repaired and somewhat upgraded from the questionable state I had obtained it in (along with a massive loan).  I must be an impressive captain I thought.  These feelings quickly faded after I had understood my new crew member was a drunk who had been partying for days and was left with no money or resources.  They boarded my ship, ate my food, and slept for nearly 3 days while I salvaged, repaired, and somehow managed to piece together a proper EVA suit with an oxygen supply for myself.

They eventually started to be helpful and my ship slowly began to be repaired and upgraded as I was able to venture further out into the void for salvage.  The journey continues.  Maybe someday I'll become a citizen of some station or planet and not struggle to just live.  Dreams can be dreams.
items.text_zh:
于是我就不知怎么地拥有了一艘船。它可不便宜，而我必须偿还的贷款还款期限正迅速逼近。我的账户里只有100信用点，所以我做了唯一合乎逻辑的事，出发去执行一次非法打捞任务（无需许可证）。显然我的运气很强；我停靠的第一艘船上就找到了一张打捞许可证，上面还剩12小时的有效时间。我迅速开始拆解这艘船上的贵重材料，而我的船则慢慢地把空气泄漏到无情的太空真空中。

我返回空间站，卖掉了我第一次闯入虚空时不知怎么设法停靠的那艘船的推进器和其他基本部件。我能够支付我的贷款还款，甚至还有停靠费，这意味着我有一些时间来修理我的船，这样至少我能指望它保持气密，让我能继续呼吸。

我一次又一次地出发，慢慢攒够了钱买一些食物、一些水，同时因为过度劳累而积累着疲惫。
	
显然我的运气是一次性事件。当我打捞了更多低价值部件后返回空间站时，我的导航控制台在接近OKLG时崩溃了。我拼命地试图调试它以重新控制飞船，但最终以超过每秒100米的速度撞上了空间站。他们并不在意，毕竟这不是第一次有新手指挥官在他们的空间站周围操作失误，但这把我撞得昏死过去。
	
我醒来时内出血、脑震荡，还有一条断臂。我的打捞所得勉强够付停靠费和买一些氧气，所以我唯一的选择就是再次驶入黑暗之中。运气又一次站在我这边，虽然只是稍微一点，因为我在废船场找到了一艘废弃的飞船，上面有大量贵重部件。我开始拆卸它们，几乎立刻就因疼痛和失血而昏了过去。我不知怎么地在简易压力服上的二氧化碳警报声中醒来，设法把一箱贵重物品拖回了我的飞船。我又去了两次，两次都昏了过去，但不知怎么地没有窒息，我带回了某个破损聚变反应堆的一些贵重部件到我的船上。

回到我的船上后，我朝OKLG飞去，轨迹稍微偏移了一点。如果我的导航计算机再次失灵，我就不会撞上任何东西。这是一个我不会忘记的教训，而获得第二台导航计算机是我心中最重要的优先事项之一。我到达了空间站，在又只因为疼痛昏过去一次之后，我设法恢复了一些打捞物品的功能，并把它们卖掉，换到了足够去医疗亭的信用点。在快速注射了纳米机器人后，我从自动售货机买了一份让我感觉自己像个百万富翁的饭，坐下来一边吃一边在电视前休息，直到我的出血停止。经历了这一切之后，我去洗漱，然后在OKLG港口某个随机肮脏房间的床上睡觉。不知怎么地，我还活着，也还没有破产。

这种情况持续着：打捞、还贷款、吃饭、睡觉。谢天谢地，这一切都没有再发生危及生命的伤害。

我终于攒够了钱，雇了我的第一个船员。我为自己能这么容易就有人加入我的船员而感到自豪。我的船从我获得它时那可疑的状态（还伴随着一笔巨额贷款）算是有了一些修理，也有了一些升级。我一定是个令人印象深刻的船长，我心想。在我明白我的新
船员是个酒鬼，已经狂欢了好几天，身无分文，也没有任何资源。他们登上了我的船，吃了我的食物，睡了将近3天，而我则在打捞、修理，并设法为自己拼凑出一套带氧气供应的像样的EVA服。

他们最终开始帮上忙了，我的船也慢慢开始被修理和升级，因为我能够冒险深入虚空进行打捞。旅程还在继续。也许有一天我会成为某个空间站或行星的公民，不再为生存而挣扎。梦想可以只是梦想。

items.text: Game is a really cool premise, and at this point (launch of 0.14.something) there's a lot of content. But after about 10-15 hours on a save with various inventories and NPC interactions and what-not, the game becomes about as stable as Charles Manson's latest girlfriend. I mean, memory leaks like the Titanic rolled up in this joint. Game constantly freezes for 2-5 seconds (and that's roughly every 30 seconds or so that it's freezing) on a save with about a dozen hours. Sure, I get that it's Early Access. And optimization typically comes after development and changes. But the save and stability just falls apart after a dozen hours, making it nearly unplayable. I keep getting loops of errors and crashes. Sometimes it just locks up my whole PC. I'm *really* looking forward to being able to play this title, but right now it's an exercise in frustration. Toss it on your watchlist and wait for more time in the oven, I'd say.
items.text_zh: 游戏的前提真的很酷，而且在这个阶段（0.14.something发布时）已经有很多内容了。但在一个存档里玩了大约10-15小时，经历了各种物品栏、NPC互动之类的东西之后，游戏的稳定性变得差不多像查尔斯·曼森最近一任女友一样稳定。我是说，内存泄漏就像泰坦尼克号卷进了这个地方。在一个大约玩了十几个小时的存档里，游戏不断冻结2-5秒（而且大约每30秒左右就会冻结一次）。当然，我明白它还在抢先体验阶段。而且优化通常是在开发和改动之后才进行的。但存档和稳定性在十几个小时后就彻底崩溃，让它几乎无法游玩。我不断遇到错误和崩溃的循环。有时它甚至会把我的整台电脑锁死。我*真的*很期待能够玩这款游戏，但现在它就是一种折磨人的练习。我会说，把它放进你的关注列表，等它在烤箱里多待一段时间吧。

[h1] 8/10 Recommended if you're acoustic [/h1]
[i] It used to be a negative review, however now its an optimistic recommended review only if you know what youre buying. I seriously do not recommend buying this blind, watch a video on Youtube comrade. [/i]

[h2]The Good [/h2]
[b]Uniqueness:[/b] Usually this catagory is for the top artistery bs or posers talking about why their ♥♥♥♥♥♥ pixel art game is so good. This is one of the exceptions where there truly is nothing like this on the $300 Billion dollar gaming market. It's like the game is set in the lore of the game Hardspace: Shipbreaker, and with the world building of NeoScavanger (Same dev).
[b]Depth: [/b] The game has incredible depth that's chosen by how much the player wishes to explore the lore. There is quests and yadada every game has it however, this game really let's you live out your dream, be a ship scrapper, pirate, living in stations, different planets and so on. 
[b]Game Size:[/b] Game is [u]2GB[/u], I can ♥♥♥♥♥ all i want but for this much content under 2GB my hats to you for making such a playable game for this game size. The game is also playable on literal hopeium which is amazing considering the pricing out of gamers in the gaming market.
[b]Tutorial:[/b] Mostly a positive, this game requires you to read the tutorial. This is not a battlefield game where the tutorial is filler. The tutorial guides you pretty well but you can still get stuck, which is why it needs to do even more handholding. This game also offers tutorials via books in the game ensuring further immersion. However the text heavy nature of the tutorials forces off platform tutorial.

[h2]The Bad [/h2]
[b]Bugs:[/b] Just like pre-release there is still a problem with the garbage collection and commands. The longer you play the game the more likely you will encounter something. People talk about CTD which i experienced pre-release and ive yet to meet it in my 10 hours, vs the 2 hours pre release. You will probably encounter framerate issues [10 fps] which again come from the garbage collection, however I did reload and it seems to have fixed it for now. 
[b]Grind:[/b] The grind should be more customizable, difficulty, and so on. In this game you can choose perks and that's fine, and there's a lot of ways to save yourself such as teleporting your ship and so on. However the grind on leveling up the character or the time it takes to build something is hellish. 

[h1] Conclusion [/h1]
Game is pretty good, I recommend it if you've played Project Zomboid, try it out. There are some serious die hard fans for this game so I recommend reading the negative reviews as they are way more informative. This game with a few QOL updates and the major update they're talking about will turn into a 9/10.
items.text_zh:
[h1] 8/10 如果你是“声学”玩家就推荐 [/h1]
[i] 这曾经是个差评，但现在它是个乐观的推荐好评，前提是你知道自己买的是什么。我强烈不建议盲买，同志，去YouTube上看个视频吧。 [/i]

[h2]优点 [/h2]
[b]独特性：[/b] 通常这个类别都是给那些顶级艺术废话或者装逼犯谈论为什么他们那♥♥♥♥♥♥像素艺术游戏有多好。这是少数例外之一，在3000亿美元的 gaming 市场上确实没有类似的东西。就像游戏设定在《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》的传说中，并且有NeoScavanger（同一开发者）的世界构建。
[b]深度：[/b] 游戏有着令人难以置信的深度，取决于玩家想探索多少传说。有任务和诸如此类的东西，每个游戏都有，然而，这个游戏真的让你实现梦想，成为拆船工、海盗、生活在空间站、不同星球等等。 
[b]游戏大小：[/b] 游戏是[u]2GB[/u]，我可以♥♥♥♥♥随便我，但对于2GB以下这么多内容，我向你们致敬，为这个游戏大小制作出如此可玩的游戏。这个游戏还能在字面意义上的“希望素”上运行，考虑到 gaming 市场上玩家的定价，这太惊人了。
[b]教程：[/b] 大多是正面的，这个游戏要求你阅读教程。这不是战地游戏，教程是填充物。教程引导得相当好，但你仍然可能卡住，这就是为什么它需要更多的牵手指导。这个游戏还通过游戏内的书籍提供教程，确保进一步的沉浸感。然而，教程的文本繁重性质迫使人们使用平台外教程。

[h2]缺点 [/h2]
[b]Bug：[/b] 就像预发布版一样，垃圾回收和命令仍然有问题。你玩得越久，越可能遇到问题。人们谈论CTD，我在预发布版经历过，但在我的10小时里还没遇到，对比预发布版的2小时。你可能会遇到帧率问题[10 fps]，这同样来自垃圾回收，然而我重新加载了，似乎暂时修复了。 
[b]刷：[/b] 刷应该更可定制，难度等等。在这个游戏里你可以选择特权，这没问题，还有很多方法拯救自己，比如传送你的飞船等等。然而，升级角色或建造某物所需时间的刷是地狱般的。 

[h1] 结论 [/h1]
游戏相当不错，如果你玩过《Project Zomboid》，我推荐试试。这个游戏有一些严肃的死忠粉丝，所以我推荐阅读负面评论，因为它们信息量更大。这个游戏通过一些QOL更新和他们谈论的重大更新将变成9/10。

items.text:
Very detailed simulations - gases, social life (for some reason), space body simulation and npc simulations.
Deep lore inspired by the best sci-fi, such as the Expanse. Very fun base gameplay cycle but a bit hard to get into.

Almost no tech issues - encountered only one sudden shutdown and only because of alt-tabing while saving the game.

Looking forward for full release. And by the way, devs update the game quite often - usually with a huge content expansions. As of right now it is fully playable with shipbreaker side of things, but anything apart from Ganymede is yet to be populated (there are stations and even some content on Venus but it is pretty early to go there and it is very expensive to do so).
items.text_zh:
非常详细的模拟——气体、社交生活（不知为何）、太空天体模拟和NPC模拟。
受最佳科幻作品（如《苍穹浩瀚》）启发的深厚背景设定。非常有趣的基础玩法循环，但有点难上手。

几乎没有技术问题——只遇到过一次突然关机，而且只是因为保存游戏时按了Alt-Tab。

期待正式发布。顺便说一句，开发者更新游戏相当频繁——通常都是大规模的内容扩展。就目前而言，拆船这一侧的内容已经完全可玩，但除了木卫三之外，其他地方还没有填充内容（有空间站，甚至金星上也有一些内容，但去那里还太早，而且这样做非常昂贵）。

[strike]Game is unplayable due to graphic glitches, could not play like 2 hours without crashing 5 times. UI freezes, while the rest keeps running, or I got the green screen, total system crash. 

I could see where this is going, and could be a very good game, but not ready yet for early access as it is so broken. I am thinking on refund but actually I want this game in a playable condition, so maybe half year later...[/strike]

[strike]Update: as of 2025 January, Still unplayable due to graphical negligence. Starts at 640*480 like we were in the '90-s, does not save proper resolution, goes back to low res. Clicks often fail, like clicking on menus just do nothing, then UI fully freezes. All the time, after 5-30 minutes. They probably do not test on AMD hardware. 

Shoddy work, should have refunded.

Update: 2025 end of april. Still unplayable due to graphics glitching and crashes. Is this a scam or developer so ignorant to blocker issues?[/strike]

Update: 2026 beginning of april, on the  public beta branch. Took like 1.5 years, but the game seems to be playable now. Great! The tutorial is still  broken, just stops guideance after the docking on the first derelict. Maybe I can remove the thumbsdown soon. At least I can now strike through the first part telling this would be unplayable. 

So, after 1.5 years I am finally able to review this.

Like
- Like the distopic asthetic. Everything is  dirty, worn. 
- Pretty detailed item  mechanics: power tools, with rechargeable or alkaline batteries.
- Many-many items: tools, wears, add-in cards, components
- Interesting and unique character creation including pre-game education and adventures.  Except the unnecessary woke things. 
- interesting flying mechanic. Quite lame with the 2D model and no computer autopilot, but using the consoles and the sounds still make it fun
- Full survival factor, with needs like food, water, cigarette, sleep, temperature, hygiene.
- Atmosphere simulation. You need proper airlock or the ship loses atmosphere... and your life. 
- Fun situations.. like I was dragging a heavy stuff on my ships patched hull and the patch flew off, and the ship was suddenly open to the space. 
- Deep gameplay mechanics like you find a body and open a case and start searching clues to provide justice.


Dislike
- I felt scammed for 1.5 years. This was ridiculously badly tested. Literally the WORST I ever bought, no other game was unplayable ever. I know people still could play it, seen youtubers. Probably hardware dependent, but I could not. Crashed like within minutes, it was so badly and carelessly designed / tested.
- Unnecessary woke aspects.
- The main loop seems odd. Why I need to spend so much time to repair the things I sell? Repair used to be an intermediate addition in the game loop to increase profit. However it is fun to repair my ship. 
- Starter ship should NOT be a randomly assigned pre-career thing. It should be selected at a kiosk at the station.
- Some starter ships are soo unusable, which would not be a problem if it wasn not randomly selected. I dragged a nav console and a few tanks then that is it, no more space, need to go sell them. There should be at least a few racks to hold the jumpsuit, food, unneded tools while salvaging and more cargo space.
- Space ships make electricity, batteries for emergencies only. There should a middle ground between battery and fusion reactor,  like fuel cells at least that takes h2 and o2 and has more endurance than battery.
- Kiosks are lame. No search, hard to find things. By default it wants to dend to barter zone.. so I bouht a coverall and 2 shooes, accidentally not dechecked the barter zone, 1 shoe is missing. It is somewhere on the ship.. seriously? Same happened when the lame auto-get-things-for-repair threw coverall pieces all over tthe ship and switched to spacesuit, I was searching for than damn shoe.
- Spacesuits are lame. It could have been awesome, but someone made it intentionally annoying. There is the pressure suit, it does not have O2 tank and CO2 filter, so you  go back and forth to refill the air inside the suit. Then there is the EVA suit, which has battery, O2 tank and CO2 filter.  But  it has a backpack piece, so you  carry the backpack or a crate in hand. 
- Item storage seems intentionally annoying. You have a rack on the ship, literally a tall  1 tile furniture, which hold 3 slots. Then  a backpack, that holds 16. Why? Wold it be painful to provide some space on the racks? like 32 slots per tile.
- Order / autotask / auto-get-things-for-repair is lame, buggy, annoying, total disaster. Lets say, I want to repair something, it needs parts, character will go collect one part, install it and go pick 1 part again.. one by one instead picking into the backpack. Order something to do... if the character finds an excuse why not to do, immediately starts doing something else. Autotask (do whatever you want) and queue (do these things I want you to do) should be different mechanics. 
- No shower? There is every game mechanic there to support it. No anymation needed, just a blacked out from top object where the character could shower in privacy. 
- Prox alert is annoying. It docking clamp engagement should auto-disable it since the ship is  not flying anymore. No point to annoyingly beep on the station. I know I can mute it, and I also know what happens when I  mute it and forget it. 
- The meat  could have been an interesting quest... but it is actually ridiculous. [spoiler]The hidden cultist/scientist/zealot stat is lame. Build an altar to teleport to a mythic monster? What the hell. Started as an experiment failure creating an uncontrollably growing meat blob.. then the goat monster and goat altar, totally unginged. Could have been clues leading to a distant derelict where a crazy scientist was experimenting with goat meat growing and planting specimen to other derelicts. Then the protagonist kills the scientist or helps him. Killing would stop the infection and acquire the weapon, helping would yield the meat grower. [/spoiler]
- Station NPC-s are lame. This is particularly annoying, since every game mechanic is there, they walk around and maintian the station. In spacesuits!! Why? They should be waling in coveralls, its pressurized. Or at least take the helpet off. 
- Station side quests are lame. I have like 10 of them, none doable. Some requires to talk to someone does not even exist in the social app, no idea where they are. No option to ask npc-s where certain people are. Others want me to beat up someone on the station.. then go to jail? 

So bottom line, finally I can thumbs this up, no longer unusable, yeeei! Stilll far from a hardcore space sim... come on, it flyes in 2D and speceship systems complexity is like kindergarten level. This is not hardcore, but hard to handle due to lame task queue system. Reentry, boy that is hardcore unit of a game.  Very good idea, good asthetics design, but lacking systems design, and very bad graphical programming, given that I could not play this so far.
items.text_zh:
[strike]由于图形故障，游戏无法游玩，玩了大约2小时就崩溃了5次。UI会冻结，而其他部分仍在运行，或者我遇到绿屏，整个系统崩溃。

我能看出这游戏的发展方向，可能会是一款非常好的游戏，但作为抢先体验版还远未准备好，因为它太破碎了。我在考虑退款，但实际上我希望这款游戏能达到可玩状态，所以也许半年后再说……[/strike]

[strike]更新：截至2025年1月，由于图形方面的疏忽，仍然无法游玩。启动时是640*480分辨率，就像我们还在90年代一样，无法保存正确的分辨率，会回到低分辨率。点击经常失败，比如点击菜单毫无反应，然后UI完全冻结。一直如此，在5-30分钟后。他们可能没有在AMD硬件上测试。

粗制滥造的工作，本该退款的。

更新：2025年4月底。由于图形故障和崩溃，仍然无法游玩。这是骗局，还是开发者对阻塞性问题如此无知？[/strike]

更新：2026年4月初，在公开测试分支上。花了大约1.5年，但游戏现在似乎可以玩了。太好了！教程仍然有问题，在第一次对接废弃飞船后就停止引导了。也许我很快就能取消差评。至少我现在可以把第一部分说这游戏无法游玩的内容划掉了。

所以，1.5年后我终于能够评价这款游戏了。

喜欢
- 喜欢这种反乌托邦美学。一切都脏兮兮、破旧不堪。
- 相当详细的物品机制：电动工具，配有可充电或碱性电池。
- 非常非常多的物品：工具、服装、扩展卡、组件
- 有趣且独特的角色创建，包括游戏前的教育和冒险。除了那些不必要的觉醒东西。
- 有趣的飞行机制。2D模型且没有电脑自动驾驶，相当蹩脚，但使用控制台和音效仍然让它很有趣
- 完整的生存要素，有食物、水、香烟、睡眠、温度、卫生等需求。
- 大气模拟。你需要正确的气闸，否则飞船会失去大气……以及你的生命。
- 有趣的情境……比如我在飞船修补过的船体上拖拽重物，补丁飞掉了，飞船突然向太空敞开。
- 深度的游戏机制，比如你发现一具尸体，打开一个箱子，开始搜寻线索以伸张正义。


不喜欢
- 我感觉被骗了1.5年。这测试得糟糕得离谱。简直是我买过的最差劲的，没有其他游戏曾经无法游玩。我知道有些人仍然能玩，看过youtuber玩。可能取决于硬件，但我不能。几分钟内就崩溃，设计/测试得如此糟糕和粗心。
- 不必要的觉醒方面。
- 主循环似乎很奇怪。为什么我需要花这么多时间修理我卖的东西？修理曾经是游戏循环中增加利润的中间环节。不过修理我的飞船很有趣。
- 初始飞船不应该是一个随机分配的职业生涯前的东西。它应该在空间站的售货亭选择。
- 有些初始飞船实在太不可用了，如果不是随机选择的话这不会是个问题。我拖了一个导航控制台和几个罐子，然后就这样了，没有更多空间，需要去卖掉它们。至少应该有几个架子来存放连体服、食物、打捞时不需要的工具，以及更多的货物空间。
- 太空飞船发电，电池仅用于紧急情况。电池和聚变反应堆之间应该有一个中间地带，比如至少燃料电池，消耗氢气和氧气，比电池有更长的续航。
- 
售货亭很烂。没有搜索功能，很难找到东西。默认情况下它想送到以物易物区……所以我买了一件连体工作服和2只鞋，不小心没有取消勾选以物易物区，1只鞋不见了。它在飞船上的某个地方……说真的？同样的事情发生在那个烂透了的自动获取修理物品功能把连体工作服碎片扔得满飞船都是并切换到太空服时，我当时就在找那只该死的鞋。
- 太空服很烂。本来可以很棒，但有人故意把它弄得烦人。有压力服，它没有氧气罐和二氧化碳过滤器，所以你得来回给服内的空气充气。然后有EVA服，它有电池、氧气罐和二氧化碳过滤器。但它有一个背包部件，所以你得背着背包或手里拿着箱子。
- 物品存储似乎故意让人烦。你在飞船上有一个架子，字面上一格高的家具，能放3个槽位。然后一个背包，能放16个。为什么？在架子上提供一些空间会痛苦吗？比如每格32个槽位。
- 订单/自动任务/自动获取修理物品很烂，有bug，烦人，彻底的灾难。比如说，我想修理某样东西，它需要零件，角色会去收集一个零件，安装它，然后再去拿1个零件……一个一个地拿，而不是装进背包。命令做某事……如果角色找到借口不做，就立刻开始做别的事。自动任务（做你想做的任何事）和队列（做这些我想让你做的事）应该是不同的机制。
- 没有淋浴？所有游戏机制都在那里支持它。不需要任何动画，只需要一个从顶部遮挡的物体，角色可以在那里私密地淋浴。
- 接近警报很烦人。对接夹接合应该自动禁用它，因为飞船不再飞行了。在空间站上烦人地哔哔叫没有意义。我知道我可以静音它，我也知道当我静音它然后忘记时会发生什么。
- 肉本来可以是一个有趣的任务……但实际上很荒谬。[剧透]隐藏的邪教徒/科学家/狂热者属性很烂。建造一个祭坛传送到一个神话怪物？搞什么鬼。开始是一个实验失败，创造了一个无法控制地生长的肉团……然后是山羊怪物和山羊祭坛，完全没解释。本来可以是线索指向一个遥远的废弃飞船，那里一个疯狂的科学家在实验山羊肉的生长，并把样本种植到其他废弃飞船上。然后主角杀死科学家或帮助他。杀死会阻止感染并获得武器，帮助会得到肉生长器。[/剧透]
- 空间站NPC很烂。这特别烦人，因为每个游戏机制都在那里，他们四处走动并维护空间站。穿着太空服！！为什么？他们应该穿着连体工作服走动，那里是加压的。或者至少把头盔摘下来。
- 空间站支线任务很烂。我有大约10个，没有一个可完成。有些需要和社交应用里根本不存在的人交谈，不知道他们在哪里。没有选项问NPC某些人在哪里。其他的想让我在空间站上揍某人……然后进监狱？

所以底线是，终于我可以给这个点赞了，不再无法使用了，耶！仍然远非硬核太空模拟……拜托，它在2D中飞行，飞船系统的复杂性就像幼儿园水平。这不是硬核，但由于烂透了的任务队列系统而难以处理。再入，天哪，那才是硬核的游戏单位。非常好的想法，好的美学设计，但缺乏系统设计，而且非常糟糕的
图形编程方面，鉴于我至今无法玩这个游戏。

items.text:
I first bought this game early 2023 - I remember the first time I played it I couldn't figure out how to get out of the apartment. There was some puzzle, repairing the door, I couldn't figure out what the game wanted me to do and after ten minutes or so of trying, I gave up, and figured I'd give the game more time to bake. A few months later, I tried again, got out of my room, couldn't find where the ship was. I dropped it again and wrote it off as a game that just wasn't for me. I stumbled across a couple of youtube playthroughs that were pretty interesting to watch - the game looked a lot more straightforward, and looked like fun. I picked it back up and... it's a really good game now. It's pretty fun. Still very complex, and still unintuative in many ways, but it's a pretty solid game now, in fact it has one of the best flight models for a space game I've seen. The salvaging/repairing/building/etc is also very good, and when I've played I can kinda tell that there's a lot more going on that I haven't seen yet. The six hours I've played has barely scratched the surface. There's still a lot I don't know, I'm constantly googling how to do certain things in game, but that's okay, because it feels worth my time it at this point. 
Ostranauts is still in early access with plenty of bugs some game breaking that I've run into a few in my short time playing - don't enter the security ship if you get boarded for example, but it is other than that stable. If you like your scifi realistic and near future, if you like roguelikes, if you like games that you need to have a manual on hand, this might be the game for you. If you're on the fence I'd recommend quill18's playthrough - it hooked me.
items.text_zh:
我在2023年初第一次买了这个游戏——我记得第一次玩的时候，我搞不懂怎么走出公寓。有个谜题，修理门，我搞不懂游戏想让我做什么，试了大约十分钟后，我放弃了，想着给游戏更多时间完善。几个月后，我又试了一次，走出了我的房间，却找不到飞船在哪里。我又放下了它，把它归类为不适合我的游戏。我偶然看到几个youtube通关视频，看起来挺有意思——游戏看起来直接多了，也看起来很好玩。我重新拿起它，然后……它现在真的是个好游戏。相当好玩。仍然非常复杂，在很多方面仍然不直观，但它现在是个相当扎实的游戏，事实上它拥有我见过的太空游戏中最棒的飞行模型之一。打捞/修理/建造等等也非常好，当我玩的时候，我能感觉到还有很多我尚未看到的内容。我玩的六个小时 barely 触及了表面。还有很多我不知道的东西，我不断在谷歌上搜索如何在游戏中做某些事情，但没关系，因为此刻它感觉值得我花时间。
Ostranauts仍处于抢先体验阶段，有很多bug，有些会破坏游戏，我在短暂游玩中遇到了几个——例如，如果你被登船，不要进入安全船，但除此之外它是稳定的。如果你喜欢现实主义和近未来的科幻，如果你喜欢roguelike，如果你喜欢需要手边有手册的游戏，这可能是适合你的游戏。如果你还在犹豫，我推荐quill18的通关视频——它吸引了我。

...i really hope and honestly believe...
Its like an alpha, even not a beta.. nobody knows when devs can fix all their jank.
Game seemed promising during first few hours - it has a tough space vibe, nice simple sound design, idea of creating your own fortress from garbage, interesting menu for flights. But it is too raw for a game that is hanging in early access during 4 years - bugs, freezes each 5 secs, shutdowns etc. Hope KitFox will give it a birth and game will get in 1 raw with CoQ and DF. But for now - nothing tells about it. Too much work ahead. And price in steam is OP. I would say its a large demo but not a game - too little content and too many bugs and totally unplayable lags. And not for 20 usd(my choice was a step of trust - i knew KitFox grabbed them 2 weeks ago and i voted w my $ for this project). 
But its not for every1, just for freaks ) like me )
Lets see what we get for ourselves in the end. But for now - stay away, unfortunately. 
And dont let youtube to sell it - its much more simple in gameplay than you can think.
And dont buy from early access ) ever.
But i really hope and honestly believe (after KitFox united w devs) that this project will be a blast like nothing else in this genre!

I'm a huge fan of any game in the niche subgenre of "space hobo sim," and while this game absolutely fits the bill, it has some issues that hurt it in the long run.

Fully realized space hobo sims typically have some sort of combat or character driven story aspect to give meaning to your scavenging, Ostranauts just doesn't really have that yet.

Give it a try and hold out for a full release, but don't expect this to be a game you can sink a hundred hours in just yet.

(Update 4/27/2025)
As much as I like this game, I can't recommend it in good faith. It has only gotten more and more unstable to the point where less than an hour into a new playthrough, it crashed at least 5 times and somehow even crashed my firefox tab and now boots with a black screen perpetually covering the ui.

I think this game really needs some extra manpower from kitfox, whether or not that's feasible is beyond me

items.text:
Short Version:
I am a fan of Firefly and the expanse to name some similar universes, and this game provides a parallel for sure to them. Replay-ability is very good with the Procedural Generation at Char Creation. Everything about this game is a simulation, done right. It may look like GTA 1 (top down), but every darn Device, Box, Bag, Item, --> builds immersion due to the screens / design / functionality. It does feel like early access, but bugs are constantly being fixed, and the bugs I experience are mostly tiny bugs that I can keep playing with. Tip: if you are really 'vibe-ing' with a character play-though, keep a save at least 1hr or more from the rest of the saves in case you move into some big bug. I list some bugs I have hit below. I recommend this game and I still play it regularly.

Long Version:
Extra Effort.
>The "Help" button on the Main Menu:  The Main Menu is a Ship's Bridge/Computer Terminal and the Help button is a literal manual (or hefty book) sitting on the desk. When clicked, that manual opens, formatted with game info, in a binder, as a tech manual would be. These fine details are very much entirely in this game.

Simulation Done Right.
>Every device menu (of a certain manufacturer) is its own unique screen with wear and tear you would expect from devices in this weathered in environment. There are no shortage of clicky knobs, toggle switches, blinky lights. These very complicated screens are actually very intuitive once you use them successfully.

Speed Up Menial Tasks.
>It has a way to speed up the game (x1, x2, x4, x8, x16), but it also has situational bad things as any sim, so the clock-increase button doesn't feel like god-mode (nor does it make you want to play less as some QoL mechanics in other games do), since speeding up time can cause any bad thing that naturally occurs in a situation to ... occur faster. Cons of speeding up time: (Police traveling your way for a routine Inspection, CO2 Buildup in the cheap Enviro Suit, Ship Power consumption, etc.) Pros of speeding up time: (Repair/Un-/Install Time, Ship travel time, Drill Battery Charge time on the manufacturer specific Battery Charger, recovering health attributes when resting, etc.)

Bugs do happen.  
>I have had one crash in 34 hours (at the time of writing this review) of game-play. 
>When I drop Items the easy way when on other items (not the correct way of - drag them to a specific floor or container location) there is a 1% chance they glitch through the floor or into nothingness (example: once dropping an empty crate onto a crate). Though, those items that I drop that way tend to be junk anyways. 
>Sometimes a bug will be shown in the drop-down dev command line interface, and they will not be directly related to what you are doing. (example: person didn't load)  You then just minimize the drop-down dev command line interface or save, quit, load for security or random peace-of-mind.
>I had a police cruiser waiting to dock with me as I was undocking from a derelict for a routine check. That pilot bumped me, then docked, putting us into a fast moving coast through space... which I didn't realize until I saved over all pre-dock save files, and created a situation where the best save I had was 60 seconds from both of our ship randomly crashing into something in our path (the kind of crash that destroys your ship and your suit).  I was okay with this (normally game-play-crushing event) since a restart meant a new char and new generated universe... that and my char was a very wanted individual which made game-play less desirable at that point. 
>A recent patch had to do with Hauler ships moving derelicts.  I now see hauler ships moving derelicts bumping stations I am docked on repeatedly stopping the time speed-up (due to prox alarm) and constantly triggering prox alarms (if toggled on). This is an obvious dumb driving AI bug or the AI cannot compensate for the load.  It will probably be patched out. It is a nuisance.  My best workaround it going to a diff station from time to time.  This is in my review to give you a good example of early access bugs that can crop up.
>It does help that reloads of the game are very fast since this game is not large from a file standpoint.

I have wanted this kind of sim for a long time and randomly came across it... I need to find a way to input Movies into a list and the output = games that feel similar.

I very much enjoy this game and recommend it.
items.text_zh:
简短版：
我是《萤火虫》和《无垠的太空》等类似宇宙设定的粉丝，而这款游戏确实为它们提供了一个平行世界。角色创建时的程序化生成让重玩性非常好。这款游戏的一切都是一场模拟，而且做得恰到好处。它看起来可能像《侠盗猎车手1》（俯视视角），但每一个该死的设备、箱子、袋子、物品——>都通过屏幕/设计/功能营造出沉浸感。它确实感觉像是抢先体验版，但bug在不断被修复，而我遇到的bug大多是些小bug，不影响我继续玩。提示：如果你真的对某个角色的游玩流程很“有感觉”，那就留一个与其他存档至少相隔1小时或更久的存档，以防你遇到什么大bug。我在下面列出了一些我遇到过的bug。我推荐这款游戏，而且我仍然经常玩它。

长版：
额外的用心。
>主菜单上的“帮助”按钮：主菜单是一个飞船舰桥/计算机终端，而帮助按钮就是放在桌上的一本实实在在的手册（或者说厚书）。点击后，那本手册会打开，里面以游戏信息排版，放在活页夹里，就像一本技术手册那样。这些精细的细节在这款游戏里比比皆是。

模拟做得恰到好处。
>每个设备菜单（来自某个特定制造商）都是它自己独特的屏幕，带有你会在这个饱经风霜的环境中从设备上预期到的磨损痕迹。可点击的旋钮、拨动开关、闪烁的指示灯应有尽有。这些非常复杂的屏幕一旦你成功使用过，实际上会变得非常直观。

加速琐碎任务。
>它有一种加速游戏的方法（x1、x2、x4、x8、x16），但它也像任何模拟游戏一样有情境性的坏事，所以加速时钟的按钮不会让人觉得像开了上帝模式（也不会像其他游戏里某些生活质量机制那样让你不想玩），因为加速时间会导致任何在某种情境下自然发生的坏事……发生得更快。加速时间的缺点：（警察为例行检查朝你赶来、廉价环保服中二氧化碳积聚、飞船电力消耗等。）加速时间的优点：（修理/卸载/安装时间、飞船旅行时间、制造商特定电池充电器上的钻头电池充电时间、休息时恢复健康属性等。）

bug确实会发生。
>在34小时（写这篇评测时）的游戏时间里，我遇到过一次崩溃。
>当我在其他物品上以简单方式丢弃物品时（不是正确的方式——把它们拖到特定的地板或容器位置），有1%的几率它们会穿模掉进地板或虚无之中（例如：有一次把一个空板条箱丢到一个板条箱上）。不过，我以那种方式丢弃的物品往往都是垃圾。
>有时bug会显示在下拉式开发者命令行界面中，而且它们不会与你正在做的事情直接相关。（例如：人物没有加载）然后你只需最小化下拉式开发者命令行界面，或者为了安全或随机求个心安而保存、退出、加载。
>我曾遇到一艘警用巡逻艇在我从一艘废弃飞船解缆离开时等着与我对接，进行例行检查。那个飞行员撞了我一下，然后对接了，把我们带入了一段高速漂移穿越太空的状态……直到我覆盖了所有对接前的存档文件后我才意识到这一点，并造成了一种情况：我最好的存档距离我们两艘飞船随机撞上路径上的某个东西（那种会摧毁你的飞船和你的宇航服的撞击）只剩60秒。我对这件事倒还接受（这通常是会毁掉游戏进程的事件），因为重新开始意味着一个新角色和一个新生成的宇宙……而且我的角色还是个被高度通缉的人物，这让那时的游戏体验没那么令人向往。

If your a fan of survival games like Classic Fallout and TV shows like Firefly your going to enjoy Ostranausts! This is the Scifi adventure game I've always dreamed someone would build, low graphics but deep story building, game play and lore. 

Big fan of Neo Scavenger! When I first saw this game, on steam, one year ago, I kept it in my wish list with hopes it would update and develop. A year later I bought the game and I couldn't be happier. For me Blue Bottle games never disappoints. They are building a game that is full of lore, depth and mysteries to uncover. I'VE LOVED EVERY MINUTE!. 

Pros:
Form ship flying, to ship building and learning how to micro manage successfully. I've been hooked by the many processes and options you are given. Its been so interesting learning how to figure things out. You can build and customise in this game that fun and very rewarding. The challenge of keeping all these moving parts together and navigating your way through the many pitfall has kept me gripped. You can achieve so much very quickly and also loss it all just as fast. I haven't even begun and i m excited by what I've sen so far.

Social interactions with NPC builds a story of its own. When I started the game I thought nothing of making enemies with NPCs but man I was so wrong. I've been ambushed, attacked and hunted by NPCs who I've made enemies of. If it wasn't for my combat knife or a hacksaw in my pocket I would have died many times. it makes the game fun by adding an extra element to think about while getting supplies or exploring.  

Cons:
A lot of bugs, but it's beta and that's  to be expected. As the game has gone on I've crashed many times due to mapping errors and dead NPCs stacking up in places like KLeg.

Flying your ship is so hard and not rewarding. For me I used the insta travel a lot. The manually piloting mini game and docking is just so exhausting. I don't have the spacial awareness to keep track of all the moving dots on screen. NPC ships crash into you so much and its frustrating. You can also be in the middle of docking/undocking your ship and get patrols wanting to board you or give you a 5000 cash fine for failing to comply. Its a learning curve I don't enjoy learning, I avoid it like the plague. If I could hire an NPC to pilot my ship for me, which I haven't tried...yet, I definitely would. it would be fun to have a star trek like NPC crew to navigate/communicate the space travel. 

YOU CAN NOT CUSTOMISE YOUR SUIT! For me this needs to be a feature. I was so disappointed that you can only have two types of space suits. I hope Blue Bottle are working on this for future updates. Adding straps, buckles and extra utilises to you suit would be so great and compliment the great ship building features. Scavenging for suit parts and adding low budget bit, in a survivalist like, makeshift type way, would be so much fun. The challenge of having your suit needing repairs and patching it up, fully repairing or dismantling it is something i am hoping for. Having a suit of many different parts that you found, restored and built yourself, is rewarding. Every part would have its own story of how you found it or had to build it. Customising a suit that works for your needs would make the early game even more interesting because your invested in creating just like in ship building. Having a costume suit for different types of situation or adding gun belts or holders for items would take the Scavenging to another level of enjoyment as you progress in game. A suit with a jet pack would be a fun end game item. 

All in all this Game is a 6 out of 10. I can see the amazing potential of this game. IN MY OPINION, What this game is and whats it can become is unlimited. With time and investment this gem will turn into an absolute diamond of game. KEEP UP THE GREAT WORK BLUE BOTTLE GAMES!

如果你是《经典辐射》这类生存游戏和《萤火虫》这类电视剧的粉丝，你会喜欢Ostranausts的！这是我一直梦想有人能做出的科幻冒险游戏，画面简陋但故事构建、玩法和背景设定都很深厚。

我是Neo Scavenger的超级粉丝！一年前我第一次在Steam上看到这款游戏时，就把它留在愿望单里，希望它能更新和发展。一年后我买了这款游戏，开心得不得了。对我来说，Blue Bottle Games从不让人失望。他们正在打造一款充满背景设定、深度和待解谜团的游戏。我爱它的每一分钟！

优点：
从飞船飞行，到飞船建造，再到学习如何成功地进行微观管理。我被游戏提供的众多流程和选项深深吸引。摸索出各种门道的过程太有意思了。你在这款游戏里可以建造和自定义，既有趣又非常有成就感。让所有这些活动部件保持运转、在众多陷阱中摸索前行的挑战让我欲罢不能。你可以很快取得很多成就，也能同样快地失去一切。我甚至还没真正开始，就已经被目前看到的东西激动到了。

与NPC的社交互动会构建出属于它自己的故事。刚开始玩的时候，我根本没把和NPC结仇当回事，但天哪，我错得太离谱了。我被那些与我结仇的NPC伏击、攻击和追猎。要不是口袋里有战斗刀或钢锯，我早就死了很多次了。这给游戏增添了额外的思考要素，在获取补给或探索时让游戏更有趣。

缺点：
很多bug，但这是测试版，也在意料之中。随着游戏进行，我因为地图错误和死掉的NPC在KLeg之类的地方堆积而崩溃了很多次。

驾驶飞船太难了，而且没有回报。对我来说，我经常用瞬间旅行。手动驾驶小游戏和对接实在太累人了。我没有那种空间感知能力，没法追踪屏幕上所有移动的小点。NPC飞船老是撞上你，真让人沮丧。你还可能在对接/脱离飞船的过程中，遇到巡逻队想登船检查，或者因为你没服从就给你开5000现金的罚单。这是我并不享受学习的学习曲线，我像躲瘟疫一样避开它。如果我能雇一个NPC替我驾驶飞船——我还没试过……暂时还没——我肯定会雇的。有一个像《星际迷航》那样的NPC船员来导航/沟通太空旅行会很有趣。

你不能自定义你的宇航服！对我来说这必须成为一个功能。我很失望你只能有两种类型的宇航服。我希望Blue Bottle正在为未来的更新做这件事。给你的宇航服加上绑带、扣环和额外的实用配件会非常棒，也能与出色的飞船建造功能相得益彰。以生存主义者那种临时拼凑的方式搜寻宇航服零件并加上低预算的小部件，会非常有趣。我希望能有这样一个挑战：你的宇航服需要修理，你要给它打补丁、完全修复或拆解它。拥有一套由你找到、修复并亲手建造的许多不同零件组成的宇航服，是很有成就感的。每个零件都会有它自己的故事，讲述你是怎么找到它或不得不建造它的。自定义一套适合你需求的宇航服会让游戏前期更加有趣，因为你会像在飞船建造中那样投入到创造之中。为不同类型的情况准备一套服装式宇航服，或者加上枪带或物品固定装置，会把搜寻的乐趣提升到另一个层次，随着你在游戏中推进。一套带喷气背包的宇航服会是个有趣的终局物品。

总而言之，这款游戏我打6分（满分10分）。我能看到这款游戏惊人的潜力。在我看来，这款游戏现在是什么样，以及它能变成什么样，都是无限的。有了时间和投入，这块宝石会变成一款绝对的钻石级游戏。继续加油，BLUE BOTTLE GAMES！

10/2025 review 
I dunno what to do with the previous reviews so I just am going to keep them below.  I was thinking I should delete it, but maybe its interesting, and maybe it adds color to my current review.  Forgive me if I ramble

I'd say this has hit what I would call early access/can recommend.  I need to caution you however, I have a lot of hours in this game so I'm already past a lot of the needed learning curve and my perceptions are not accurate to a new player.  You are going to be slapped in the face with the amount of crap you need to know & get comfortable doing required things without thinking about it and you are going to be frustrated when you don't realize your starting space suit has no air supply to it, or that you have to and can move your flashlight and tools around your inventory, or you forget to put the helmet on or off to refresh the oxygen, or the fact that the ship airlock is poorly done so you won't be using it properly, or what the hell do all these things on my debt ship do since none of them look intuitive.  Expect to spend a lot of time looking up answers on youtube lets plays or google.

They still has a fair bit to add, but  it feels like they are midway through the beta.  No real story content yet and I think this game will be in DIRE need of it relative to what the devs have planned/ going to copy the mini storys of neo scavenger.

This is very much a "hardcore" game where you will get satisfaction from 2 things:  Realizing how screwed you are at the beginning of the game and trying to figure out how to get out of Debt Hell, and watching your stuff count, ship size and numbers go up.

Outside of those two things, there's nothing really satisfying.  The game's design feels like it was designed by an engineer with an extra dose of introverted engineerness.  What I mean by that is most of the mechanics were designed with "step by step what does a person need" "Step by step how do I slowly put a ship together"  "step by step how do I do x."  Sure its not that detailed versus real life, but I feel like this game was designed by a sentient technical manual.

You build your ship up not because your ship is cool but because you want to be annoyed less.  Its kind of neat that you can put in living quarters and an extra crew mate and toilets for them and exercise machines yada yada but none of those elements are really satisfying because the underlying game is almost meant to be meticulous with very little payoff besides removing things that annoy you.

You run around trying to erase your debt because of the regular payments that feel game ending.  You run around trying to build your ship so you can more effectively scavenge and erase your debt.  You run around nice-afying your ship because you got a crewmate and you don't want them to leave or be unhappy.  Its a game that pushes you and you enjoy rising to the challenge.  Look at all of the hours I've spent on the game.  There is something there, but I feel like a lot of those hours were my guys 24/7 wearing full space gear and working a ship building/scavenging shift.  It almost felt like I was watching a job.

Some elements of the game represent the dev's willingness to think in wacky ways outside of game design norms.  I don't think anyone playing the game thinks well of the social interaction and needs system.  It just feels needlessly complicated and when understood, unnecessary.  Oh no your crewmate misses his family! Click the social buttons and watch as that crewmate slowly writes home 3 separate times *poof* fixed, now he no longer misses home.  I don't want to sound to harsh because its that very dev's willingness to do new game systems that makes his game so interesting but it ends up being less desirable after time goes on.  Nor does it feel very realistic.  Your guy who misses home, that writes back home 3x times is not doing it in a comfortable chair in well lit personal quarters- hes doing it in a 24/hr wearing stinky space suit in a poorly lit derelict with broken ♥♥♥♥ everywhere in the vacuum of space.

You constantly get pinged social requests that are unrewarding and pointless- "hey buddy can you give me 20 scrap and I'll like you more"  "hey buddy I want a non-binary lover, can you get me that"  "Hey buddy can you tell someone to leave me alone." "Hey buddy" "Hey buddy" "Hey buddy"
You will feel next to 0 motivation to fulfill these requests and they will linger on your screen.  When you click remove to them, more of them will pop up as if you are being haunted by the games social request system.

I haven't fired up my reactor to run long range with my ship yet- about 90% ready for it but I don't think I want to go that far either since I don't see a lot of content there.   There is more money doing that I think, but since you cobble together ships there is need to since there is nothing you are really going to want with the money-  there is no "I need to get money because THAT SHIP IS SO COOL".

if I think of anything else to add I'll drop it in this updated.

Scavenging is fun, but its poorly done.  The load screens are a nightmare, there are still bugs, most things don't totally make sense. 7/19/2024 update
--------------------
One year later I gave it a swing.  I'm seeing optimization, less crashes and less bugs.  Load screens are now downgraded from nightmare to just annoying. Bug level has dropped down to mildly annoying.  The game freezes for too long whenever it auto saves.

Now that the game feels a bit cleaner the choices dev made feel poorly planned.  K-Leg has  a couple of different zones and I don't understand why that's needed/ it just introduces annoying loading screens.

I took 2 quests the game sent my way from my contacts and o boy are they stupid:
  I completed one quest by going to load area A, asking for the quest, then going to load area B, asking a 2nd person about the quest and then back to A to speak to original quest giver.  Quest complete.......

My 2nd quest was to find a non binary/gay lover for someone.  So I went around the station asking if they would be a non-binary/gay lover for the quest giver.  After asking 3-4 people I then asked the quest giver from quest 1 and he said yes.  Quest complete.....

I stabbed 2 pirates in this run through.  That's new, but not really different.  Now when you scavenge stuff bring a knife and a combat skill.

The worst part is that....I already have had fun with Ostranauts.  This replay one year later I got the same fun as from last year.  I really didn't experience the year of changes and while I could go seek out the new supernatural stuff , I feel like its just going to be disappointing and not worth it.  I could go out and buy a ship or build out my own...but again it doesn't seem to be worth it to me.  Nothing is really fluid/seamless in the game so I don't feel like its worth all the jank to go exploring and enjoy meh experiences or building a ship and having a crew in it with dumb social mini game.

2025年10月评论
我不知道该怎么处理之前的评论，所以我就把它们留在下面了。我本来想删掉它，但也许它挺有意思的，也许它能给我当前的评论增添点色彩。如果我啰嗦了，请原谅我

我想说这游戏已经达到了我会称之为抢先体验/可以推荐的程度。不过我得提醒你，我在这游戏里已经玩了很多小时，所以我早就越过了很多必要的学习曲线，我的看法对新玩家来说并不准确。你会被迎面而来的大量你需要知道的东西打脸，还得习惯不假思索地做那些必须做的事，而且当你没意识到你初始的太空服没有供气、或者你得在物品栏里挪动手电筒和工具、或者你忘了戴上或摘下头盔来刷新氧气、或者飞船气闸做得太烂所以你根本没法正确使用它、或者我欠债的那艘船上这些东西到底是干嘛的因为它们看起来一点都不直观时，你会感到沮丧。准备好花大量时间在YouTube实况或谷歌上查答案吧。

他们还有相当多东西要加，但感觉他们正处在测试版的中途。还没有真正的剧情内容，而且我认为相对于开发者所计划的/将要照抄《新拾荒者》那些小故事而言，这游戏会极其需要剧情。

这非常是一款“硬核”游戏，你会从两件事中获得满足感：意识到自己在游戏开局时处境有多惨，并设法弄清楚如何摆脱债务地狱；以及看着你的物资数量、飞船规模和数字往上涨。

除了这两件事之外，真没什么让人满足的。这游戏的设计感觉像是一个工程师设计的，还额外加了一份内向的工程宅气质。我的意思是，大多数机制都是按照“一步一步，一个人需要什么”“一步一步，我怎么慢慢把一艘飞船拼起来”“一步一步，我怎么做X”来设计的。当然，跟现实生活比起来没那么细致，但我感觉这游戏就像是由一本有自我意识的技术手册设计的。

你升级你的飞船，不是因为你的飞船很酷，而是因为你想少受点烦。你能装上居住舱、多一名船员、给他们配马桶和健身器材之类的，这确实有点意思，但这些元素没有哪个真正让人满足，因为底层游戏几乎就是刻意追求一丝不苟，除了移除那些烦你的东西之外几乎没什么回报。

你四处奔波试图抹掉你的债务，因为那些定期付款感觉会让游戏直接结束。你四处奔波试图建造你的飞船，这样你就能更有效地拾荒并抹掉你的债务。你四处奔波把你的飞船弄得舒服点，因为你有了一个船员，你不想他们离开或不开心。这是一款推动你前进的游戏，而你喜欢迎难而上。看看我在这游戏上花了多少小时吧。那里确实有点东西，但我感觉其中很多小时都是我的角色24/7穿着全套太空装备，干着造飞船/拾荒的班。几乎感觉像是我在看一份工作。

游戏的一些元素体现了开发者愿意以古怪的方式跳出游戏设计常规去思考。我不认为任何玩这游戏的人会对社交互动和需求系统有好评价。它就是感觉没必要地复杂，而一旦理解了，又觉得没必要。哦不，你的船员想家了！点击社交按钮，然后看着那个船员慢慢往家里写3封独立的信*噗*修好了，现在他不再想家了。我不想说得太苛刻，因为正是那位开发者愿意做新游戏系统的意愿让他的游戏如此有趣，但随着时间推移，它最终变得不那么令人满意。它感觉也不太真实。你那个想家的家伙，往家里写3封信，可不是坐在光线充足的个人舱室里舒适的椅子上写的——他是在24小时穿着发臭的太空服，在一个光线昏暗、真空里到处是破烂玩意儿的废弃飞船里写的。

你会不断收到毫无回报又毫无意义的社交请求——“嘿哥们，能给我20个废料吗，我会更喜欢你”“嘿哥们，我想要个非二元性别恋人，你能给我弄来吗”“嘿哥们，你能叫某个人别烦我吗。”“嘿哥们”“嘿哥们”“嘿哥们”

I would recommend this game, except for some serious concerns about the state of the game's stability. I know there is a desire for the type of crunchy life sim set in space this game is trying to be. However, the bugginess of the game as it now stands makes it extremely hard to appreciate it. I look forward to the point in time when I can rewrite this review because the game plays without constantly locking up every time it auto saves or whenever it randomly gets a whim to do so. 

Foe now, follow the development, but hold off syncing time and money into the game unless you are interested in helping the dev troubleshoot.

Edit: After further developments, I've begun to come around on this game. It is still the chunky experience I wanted, and more updates have made it more playable. I will continue to follow the development and look forward to further updates.

items.text:
Its frustrating, the setting, the atmosphere is all incredible and if you feel like you can hold out it will probably be worth it. I would be lying if I didnt enjoy myself for the 13~ hours I have put in however the experience was marred by bugs and crashes and irritable ai.

I played the game on alpha release and the game doesnt feel like much has really changed. The fundamental fusion reactor you get as an end/mid game is extremely cool but it eats over 20 tons of fuel a day at almost $300,000 a day to run where the reactor itself is about $100,000 and your entire ship could be easily priced at the amount of fuel you burn in a day. I cannot tell if this is a bug or not as this has been a feature since late 2020 and the excerpts I could find from the developer have been largely unclear as to if this is intentional or not. The solution I have seen online is to turn your reactor on for bursts, which brings the other main issue of extreme micromanagement where gameplay is inventory management mixed with trying to juggle crew members between loading screens.

The early game though is incredibly solid, salvaging and choosing parts for your starter ship before finding a holy grail in tact hull for you to move into like a techno hermit crab. The dialogue with npc I think is also really well done however I would appreciate it if there were less dialogue options or at least more distinct options outside trying to fill your meters up.

Its a largely painful experience at the moment but there is still a really engaging game underneath it all.
items.text_zh:
这很令人沮丧，设定、氛围都很棒，如果你觉得自己能坚持住，那可能最终是值得的。如果我说我在投入的13~个小时里没有玩得开心，那我就是在撒谎，但这段体验被bug、崩溃和烦人的AI破坏了。

我在alpha发布时玩了这款游戏，感觉并没有太大变化。你在游戏中期/后期获得的基础聚变反应堆非常酷，但它每天消耗超过20吨燃料，运行费用接近每天30万美元，而反应堆本身大约10万美元，你整艘船的价格可能很容易就等于你一天烧掉的燃料量。我无法判断这是不是bug，因为从2020年底以来这一直是个特性，而我能找到的开发者摘录大多不清楚这是否是有意为之。我在网上看到的解决方案是让反应堆间歇性开启，这就带来了另一个主要问题：极度的微观管理，游戏玩法变成了库存管理，再加上试图在加载画面之间调度船员。

不过早期游戏非常扎实，打捞并为你的初始飞船挑选部件，然后找到一艘完好船体的圣杯，像一只科技寄居蟹一样搬进去。我认为与NPC的对话也做得非常好，但如果对话选项能少一些，或者至少除了试图填满你的仪表之外有更多不同的选项，我会很感激。

目前这总体上是一种痛苦的体验，但在这一切之下仍然有一款非常引人入胜的游戏。

This game has some great potential, but it needs a lot of work.  Even with its very limited content and frustrating bugs, I love the salvaging and building aspect.  I've had to restart a few times due to soft locking bugs, but the latest playthrough has been going on for about 15 hours.  I've salvaged a ton of derelicts and used those parts to expand my salvage tug into a salvage hauler.  It's fun to work within the confines of money, vacuum and what you can scrounge in the ship graveyard.  I don't know, I just find it relaxing and fun.

the good:
charming graphics
a good building system
planned lore
engaged developer
detailed development roadmap with reasonable goals and timelines
active community
will have/has modding support
have to build relationships with NPC to recruit them to your crew
the social system its pretty good (interacting with NPCS)

the bad:
limited modules
limited content (basically building and salvaging)
controlling hired crew is tedious and generally not beneficial
game breaking bugs and gameplay elements that are implemented, but not fleshed-out correctly
limited guide/tutorials
immersion-breaking elements
small team (slower updates / improvements)

So, a few comments regarding the bad.
There is no penalty for over pressurizing your ship.  You can just set the vents to pump out pure oxygen to pressures that would crush coal to diamonds and then you can put on your pressure suit and basically have massive amounts of oxygen to avoid having to go from derelict to your ship to change out your air. 

The crew doesn’t follow orders.  I’ve tried to get a crewman back to my ship and just gave up as they didn’t listen.  I left the station without him, salvaged a derelict, returned to station, he’s no where to be found.  Still in my crew list.  On that, you can’t tab through crewman.  You have to see them to switch to them.  I took control of a crewman, used the transit system on the station, returned him to my ship then couldn’t switch back to my captain.  Had to revert the save.

I feel, having been following the development and the forums, that the developer is present.  Having a small team isn’t bad, but the EA was a bit early due to limited content.

The bugs with some game aspects, like local security is not good and should not be implemented until it’s sorted out.  

That being said, I find this highly enjoyable and look forward to further development.  It’s a diamond in the rough for sure, but its got great potential.

船员不服从命令。我试过让一名船员回到我的船上，最后放弃了，因为他们根本不听。我没带他就离开了空间站，打捞了一艘废弃飞船，回到空间站，他哪儿都找不到。却还在我的船员列表里。说到这个，你没法用Tab键在船员之间切换。你必须看到他们才能切换到他们。我控制了一名船员，使用了空间站上的交通系统，把他送回了我的船，然后就切不回我的船长了。只好回退存档。

我觉得，鉴于我一直关注开发和论坛，开发者是确实在场的。团队小不是坏事，但抢先体验版因为内容有限而推出得有点早。

某些游戏方面的bug，比如本地安保，很糟糕，在解决之前就不该实装。

话虽如此，我觉得这游戏非常好玩，期待后续开发。它绝对是块璞玉，但潜力巨大。

Rushed into 1.0 completely unfinished, barren of content, and full of bugs. The dev is ignoring this completely and deciding to delete and censor anything negative while only responding to positive comments which means they are well aware of what they've done.

The game is near undecipherable, there's crap scattered all over the floor and if you start playing the game you will have no idea what any of it is, everything's got 500 menus, all of them are just bare menus with no user friendly design. It's just ugly, along with the characters

I am giving this game a positive review, because I really enjoyed my time with it (for the most part, see below), and if the features that aren't in it yet make it into the final game, it will be epic. 

**HOWEVER**

If you are on the fence at all about buying it now or waiting, I recommend waiting. 

 The actual content that is currently in the game was well worth the price to me. I really enjoyed flying around and salvaging. I found a nice big freighter with barely any damage or anything missing and patched it up. Then I began collecting parts and laying out plans for remodelling the interior to make it exactly how I wanted it. I was really loving this game.

I could overlook it's jankiness, because of the fun I was having otherwise.  Sometimes I would attempt to put objects on the floor of my ship and they'd vanish completely. I lost an entire crate full of equipment to this bug. Sometimes my character would get stuck and I'd have to reload a save, losing an hour of gameplay. A salvaged door wouldn't fit on the floor, so I couldn't put it down, but then it wouldn't go back into my inventory either so every time I opened the inventory I'd have this door in my hand again and couldn't do anything else. Reload a save, lose progress. 

As I said, I could live with all that. Save more often, shrug it off.  However, the early access jank chose a new form just now and it broke my enthusiasm.  I am 18 hours in, and still had my original starting character. Just now I was playing and the game bugged out again. I opened a context menu for a door or something, but it wouldn't let me select anything. Frozen again, no huge deal. I saved and exited to menu. Tried to continue from the save, which has always worked before. Nope. Get an error screen saying program has to restart. Close it, try again. No dice, same message.

There is only one save file, so when it inevitably gets corrupted, that game is done. It's infuriating.

18 hours down the drain. I don't have the patience or the desire to start over from scratch, especially knowing it will just happen again. So I'm going to wait until this game is much further along in development before playing it again. I know it is Early Access and bugs are the norm. I can deal with nuisances, but completely losing my save is where I draw the line.

So, if you think the game looks like fun, you will probably have fun with it. What is there was worth the price, when it worked. If, however, losing all your progress after many hours of play will piss you off (as it did me), then you'd be better off waiting until the game is much further along.


**Update-4/14/20***

I got over the anger at losing my save and started over. Played 10 more hours and enjoyed my time in the game. I'm still going to recommend waiting a bit for bug fixes if you feel like that will aggravate you.  There's also not a ton of content, aside from the basic loop of flying around and salvaging, and fixing up your ship. 10 hours into my new game and I'm rich beyond my ability to spend it. There are a few more things I've yet to try, but not much.

Still, I enjoyed it for 28 hours so far, and do not regret the purchase.
